newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-KEEGAN DASHES GINOLA'S HOPES OF LIFE IN THE FAST LANE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-KEEGAN DASHES GINOLA'S HOPES OF LIFE IN THE FAST LANE.

text.p: Newcastle manager Kevin Keegan put his foot down on Wednesday to stop his French winger David Ginola from taking up motor racing.

Ginola, featured in a new Renault advertisement on television, had been talking to the car manufacturers about racing in next year's British touring car championship and was set to test drive a Renault Laguna with leading Swiss driver Alain Menu next week.
However, he had acknowledged that the English premier league club's insurance policy might prevent him from fulfilling his wish and Keegan quickly confirmed that.
"As long as he's got a contract with this club he won't be driving racing cars," said Keegan. "He's already been refused permission and he'll be refused permission again.
"David Ginola can drive racing cars when he decides to pack in football. But he certainly won't be allowed to test-drive racing cars while I'm manager of this club, and I think he knows that.
"We must not get carried away with these things. It's a publicity stunt for the launch of a television commercial."
